name: POST /api/leadflow/routing/simulate - replay, zero side effects
description:
Replays a historical window through the current configuration and reports which rule WOULD have matched.

ZERO SIDE EFFECTS BY CONSTRUCTION: the simulation never calls the assignment SDK, so there is no code path from here to a real assignment, notification or clock. A rep who gets a notification from a simulation stops trusting the simulation.

THE NUMBER THAT MATTERS IS would_route_differently, not the match count. "412 leads matched" says nothing about whether a change is safe; "38 would have gone to a different rep" does. Leads matching no rule are counted separately, because a growing unmatched number is a configuration gap rather than a routing failure. QA: measured live over 90 days — 5000 replayed, 1679 would route differently, 3302 unmatched.

testCases.name: The replay reports what would change, with no assignments made
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the window is absent, non-numeric or out of range.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
